proposed_capability: P97 prior-art mechanisms (Nav2 bounded trajectory failure handling, active-perception information gain, quintic minimum jerk), followed by P141 opportunity selection: harden the existing camera reassessment planner with explicit opt-in, independent evidence classes, pending-outcome and recent-view anti-oscillation guards, and a bounded quintic proposal. Fifth Gear develops/tests/ships the smallest original owner, no parallel runtime actuator.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only pure planning under explicit motion-proposal opt-in. Does not install a daemon, read private saves, move the cursor, suppress system controls or observe a user's desktop. Requires independent host side player/scene/save/lot rechecks for any future actuation.
expected_outcome: Default no motion, no motion during pending unverified view observation, no replay/backtrack to recent views, stronger distinct-class observation provenance, minimum-jerk one-sweep candidates, deterministic order and static cost bounds. Candidate remains advisory only.
negative_tests: Without opt-in, no motion even if candidate suggests novelty
Missing or duplicate observation-source classes deny camera motion
Pending unverified outcome blocks another gesture
Two+ recent viewpoints suppress repetitive A-B-A-B movement
Stale rev and player activity deny
Quintic path monotone and zero endpoint velocity/acceleration analytical
No activation/hidden daemon, one gesture at most, never execution permit
rollback_path: Revert isolated change set; no user game/file state migrated; original opt-in-free planning can be restored after review.
unresolved_unknowns: No local real Sims camera sensor/runtime for P08
PR159 independently owns actual sensor/CV output
No verified EA native geometry decoder
No live background motion permitted without explicit user/host approval
decision_rationale: P141 compared (A) background crawler/desktop hook REJECT privacy+OS scope; (B) new dense SLAM duplicate REJECT unavailable sensors and existing owner; (C) quintic alone INSUFFICIENT because repeated stale views still move; (D) strengthen current observation_sweep with opt-in, feedback gating, source-class provenance and quintic profile SELECT high value low risk. P97 inspected real ROS Nav2 source and research on active perception and quintic interpolation; no code/license copied.
